```{r preamble}
# load libraries
library(Cairo)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)

save_path <- "../../results/satmut_promoters_analysis/satmut_promoters_individual_promoters/"
genelist_path <- "../../results/satmut_promoters_analysis/satmut_promoters_overall_promoters/"
dir.create(save_path, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

satmut_promoters_gene_metadata <- as_tibble(fread("../../data/satmut_promoters_preprocess/satmut_promoters_gene_metadata/satmut_promoters_gene_metadata.txt.gz"))

satmut_promoters_final_prom_all <- as_tibble(fread("../../data/satmut_promoters_preprocess/satmut_promoters_final_prom/satmut_promoters_final_prom_all.txt.gz")) %>% 
  filter(analysis_version == "promoter_250bp")

# Helper: load base-level data for one gene
load_satmut_base_for_gene <- function(gene) {
  gene_meta <- satmut_promoters_gene_metadata %>%
    filter((gene_name == gene) | (id == gene) | (ensembl_gene == gene) | (ensembl_tx == gene))
  gene_chr <- gene_meta$seqnames
  gene_id  <- gene_meta$id
  as_tibble(fread(paste0(
    "../../data/satmut_promoters_preprocess/satmut_promoters_final_base/satmut_promoters_final_base_",
    gene_chr, ".txt.gz"
  ))) %>%
    filter(in_promoter_250bp, !in_all_exon_splice, id == gene_id)
}

# Shared theme for grid-friendly panels
shared_theme <- theme_cowplot(font_size = 9) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1/3,
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "italic"),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 4, 2, 4)
  )

# Distance-to-TSS plot
make_dist_plot <- function(tb, gene, show_x_title = TRUE, show_y_title = TRUE, show_gene_title = TRUE) {
  p <- ggplot(tb) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_point(aes(x = tss_dist, y = avgKHS_skew_base, color = phyloP_mam241_pos_base), size = 0.8) +
    shared_theme +
    scale_colour_gradient2(
      low = "#a6611a", mid = "grey90", high = "#66c2a5",
      midpoint = 0, limits = c(0, 9)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = if (show_x_title) "Distance to TSS" else NULL,
      y = if (show_y_title) "Mean allelic skew" else NULL,
      color = "max(0, phyloP)"
    ) +
    ylim(global_skew_ylim) +
    xlim(c(-250, 0))

  if (show_gene_title) {
    p <- p + ggtitle(bquote(italic(.(gene))))
  } else {
    p <- p + ggtitle(NULL)
  }
  p
}

# Skew-vs-phyloP plot
make_skew_plot <- function(tb, gene_id, show_x_title = TRUE, show_y_title = TRUE) {
  prom <- filter(satmut_promoters_final_prom_all, id == gene_id)
  rho_pos  <- prom$correlation_mam241_vs_avgKHS_rho_est_pos
  pval_pos <- prom$correlation_mam241_vs_avgKHS_rho_pval_pos
  rho_neg  <- prom$correlation_mam241_vs_avgKHS_rho_est_neg
  pval_neg <- prom$correlation_mam241_vs_avgKHS_rho_pval_neg

  ggplot(tb) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_point(aes(x = avgKHS_skew_base, y = phyloP_mam241_pos_base, color = avgKHS_skew_base), size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(aes(x = avgKHS_skew_base, y = phyloP_mam241_pos_base), linewidth = 0.6) +
    shared_theme +
    theme(plot.title = element_blank()) +
    scale_colour_gradient2(
      low = "#fc8d62", mid = "grey95", high = "#8da0cb",
      midpoint = 0, limits = c(-2.1, 2.1)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = if (show_x_title) "Mean allelic skew" else NULL,
      y = if (show_y_title) "max(0, phyloP)" else NULL,
      color = "Mean allelic skew"
    ) +
    xlim(c(-2.1, 2.1)) +
    ylim(c(0, 11)) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
             label = paste0("\u03c1 = ", signif(rho_neg, 2), ", p = ", signif(pval_neg, 2)),
             hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.3, size = 2) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
             label = paste0("\u03c1 = ", signif(rho_pos, 2), ", p = ", signif(pval_pos, 2)),
             hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.3, size = 2)
}

# Build a single gene panel (for individual saves)
make_gene_panel <- function(gene) {
  tb <- load_satmut_base_for_gene(gene)
  write_tsv(tb, gzfile(paste0(save_path, "satmut_prom_individual_", gene, ".txt.gz")))

  gene_meta <- satmut_promoters_gene_metadata %>%
    filter((gene_name == gene) | (id == gene) | (ensembl_gene == gene) | (ensembl_tx == gene))
  gene_id <- gene_meta$id

  d <- make_dist_plot(tb, gene, show_x_title = FALSE, show_y_title = TRUE, show_gene_title = TRUE)
  s <- make_skew_plot(tb, gene_id, show_x_title = TRUE, show_y_title = TRUE)

  d / s + plot_layout(ncol = 1, guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal")
}

# Build composite grid
# genes: character vector of gene names
# ncol_genes: number of gene columns
build_composite <- function(genes, ncol_genes) {
  n <- length(genes)
  nrow_genes <- ceiling(n / ncol_genes)

  dist_plots <- vector("list", n)
  skew_plots <- vector("list", n)

  for (i in seq_along(genes)) {
    gene <- genes[i]
    row_idx <- ceiling(i / ncol_genes)
    col_idx <- ((i - 1) %% ncol_genes) + 1

    is_left   <- col_idx == 1
    is_bottom <- row_idx == nrow_genes

    tb <- load_satmut_base_for_gene(gene)
    gene_meta <- satmut_promoters_gene_metadata %>%
      filter((gene_name == gene) | (id == gene) | (ensembl_gene == gene) | (ensembl_tx == gene))
    gene_id <- gene_meta$id

    dist_plots[[i]] <- make_dist_plot(tb, gene,
      show_x_title = FALSE,
      show_y_title = is_left,
      show_gene_title = TRUE
    )
    skew_plots[[i]] <- make_skew_plot(tb, gene_id,
      show_x_title = is_bottom,
      show_y_title = is_left
    )
  }

  # Interleave: for each gene-row, all dist plots then all skew plots
  ordered <- list()
  for (row in seq_len(nrow_genes)) {
    idx_start <- (row - 1) * ncol_genes + 1
    idx_end   <- min(row * ncol_genes, n)
    ordered <- c(ordered, dist_plots[idx_start:idx_end])
    ordered <- c(ordered, skew_plots[idx_start:idx_end])
  }

  wrap_plots(ordered, ncol = ncol_genes) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal")
}

# Load gene lists
top_genes_both <- fread(paste0(genelist_path, "satmut_prom_genelist_both.txt"), header = FALSE, col.names = "gene_name") |> as_tibble()
top_genes_pos  <- fread(paste0(genelist_path, "satmut_prom_genelist_pos.txt"),  header = FALSE, col.names = "gene_name") |> as_tibble()
top_genes_neg  <- fread(paste0(genelist_path, "satmut_prom_genelist_neg.txt"),  header = FALSE, col.names = "gene_name") |> as_tibble()

# Featured trio
trio_genes <- c("LDLR", "CCR10", "TNKS2")

# 3x5 sets (top 12, with exclusions)
genes_3x5_both <- head(top_genes_both %>% filter(gene_name != "CCR10") %>% .$gene_name, 20)
genes_3x5_neg  <- head(top_genes_neg  %>% filter(gene_name != "TNKS2") %>% .$gene_name, 20)
genes_3x5_pos  <- head(top_genes_pos  %>% .$gene_name, 20)

all_genes <- unique(c(trio_genes, genes_3x5_both, genes_3x5_neg, genes_3x5_pos))

# Pre-compute global y-limits across all genes
print("Pre-computing global y-limits across all genes...")
global_skew_range <- c(Inf, -Inf)
for (gene in all_genes) {
  tb <- load_satmut_base_for_gene(gene)
  r <- range(tb$avgKHS_skew_base, na.rm = TRUE)
  global_skew_range[1] <- min(global_skew_range[1], r[1])
  global_skew_range[2] <- max(global_skew_range[2], r[2])
}
global_skew_max <- ceiling(max(abs(global_skew_range)) * 10) / 10
global_skew_ylim <- c(-global_skew_max, global_skew_max)
print(paste0("Global skew y-limits: [", global_skew_ylim[1], ", ", global_skew_ylim[2], "]"))

# Save individual gene panels
for (gene in all_genes) {
  print(paste0("Saving individual panel for ", gene))
  p <- make_gene_panel(gene)
  ggsave(paste0(save_path, "satmut_prom_individual_", gene, "_combined.pdf"),
         plot = p, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# 3x1 composite: LDLR, CCR10, TNKS2
print("Building 3x1 trio composite...")
p_trio <- build_composite(trio_genes, ncol_genes = 4)
ggsave(paste0(save_path, "satmut_prom_composite_trio.pdf"),
       plot = p_trio, width = 7, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)

# 3x5 composites
print("Building 3x5 composite: both...")
p_both <- build_composite(genes_3x5_both, ncol_genes = 4)
ggsave(paste0(save_path, "satmut_prom_composite_3x5_both.pdf"),
       plot = p_both, width = 9, height = 11, device = cairo_pdf)

print("Building 3x5 composite: neg...")
p_neg <- build_composite(genes_3x5_neg, ncol_genes = 4)
ggsave(paste0(save_path, "satmut_prom_composite_3x5_neg.pdf"),
       plot = p_neg, width = 9, height = 11, device = cairo_pdf)

print("Building 3x5 composite: pos...")
p_pos <- build_composite(genes_3x5_pos, ncol_genes = 4)
ggsave(paste0(save_path, "satmut_prom_composite_3x5_pos.pdf"),
       plot = p_pos, width = 9, height = 11, device = cairo_pdf)

print("Done!")
```
